finding: Slovak firms' bank loan availability expectations diverged from improving EA trend
bullets: A net 6% of Slovak firms (n=104) expected bank loan availability to deteriorate, worsening 1.3 pp from the previous wave, while EA firms' expectations improved 1.5 pp to a net 2% expecting deterioration (n=2803).
Slovak trade credit expectations improved by 4.0 pp to a net 6% expecting deterioration (n=90), reversing the prior wave's pessimism, even as EA trade credit expectations edged 1.0 pp more adverse.
Slovak credit line availability expectations improved by 3.2 pp to a net 4% expecting deterioration (n=136), narrowing the gap with the EA's net 2%, though both remained in negative territory.
chart_subtitle: A net 6% of Slovak firms expected bank loan availability to deteriorate.
